theorem g_eventually_palindrome_base10_new : (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ k : ℕ, IsPalindrome10 (lychrelStep^[k] n)) ↔ (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ¬ IsLychrel10 n) := by

  · intro h n hn
    intro hL
    -- If n is Lychrel, then no iterate is a palindrome.

    rcases h n hn with ⟨k, hk⟩
    exact hno k hk
  · intro h n hn

    by_contra hnone
    push_neg at hnone
    -- hnone : ∀ k : ℕ, ¬ IsPalindrome10 (lychrelStep^[k] n)
    -- If no iterate is a palindrome, then n is Lychrel.
    have hL : IsLychrel10 n := by
      unfold IsLychrel10
      intro k
      exact hnone k
    exact h n hn hL

namespace Erdos1052

theorem g_isUnitaryPerfect_60_new : IsUnitaryPerfect 60 := by
  unfold IsUnitaryPerfect
  norm_num [properUnitaryDivisors]
  -- The goal is: ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 60 with i ∣ 60 ∧ i.Coprime (60 / i), i = 60
  -- We compute the sum by evaluating the filter. The unitary divisors of 60 are 1, 3, 4, 5, 12, 15, 20, 60.
  -- The proper unitary divisors (excluding 60) are 1, 3, 4, 5, 12, 15, 20, whose sum is 60.
  -- We prove this by showing the filter equals the explicit set and then using norm_num.
  have h_filter : (Finset.Ico 1 60).filter (fun i => i ∣ 60 ∧ i.Coprime (60 / i)) =
      {1, 3, 4, 5, 12, 15, 20} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases h with ⟨⟨h1, h60⟩, hcop⟩
      -- h1 : 1 ≤ i, h60 : i < 60, hcop : i.Coprime (60 / i)
      -- We need to show i is one of these numbers. Since i ∣ 60 and i < 60, i is a proper divisor of 60.
      -- The divisors of 60 are 1,2,3,4,5,6,10,12,15,20,30. But we also need coprimality.
      -- We can use omega/norm_num to enumerate. Since i is a natural number with 1 ≤ i and i < 60,
      -- we can use interval_cases.
      interval_cases i <;> simp_all [Nat.Coprime, Nat.gcd_eq_right, Nat.gcd_eq_left] <;> norm_num at hcop ⊢
    · intro h
      simp at h
      rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
  rw [h_filter]
  norm_num

end Erdos1052
